items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: That was recorded, that “Modern Art Suite” by the New York Saxophone Quartet. Ray Beckenstein is sort of the leader of that group

ctx.x: I know that your saxophone work too has gotten around, as we can see from this program in Japanese. Very interesting.
That was recorded, that “Modern Art Suite” by the New York Saxophone Quartet. Ray Beckenstein is sort of the leader of that group, a wonderful group of players.
Did your years in the big bands help you figure out what saxophones should and shouldn’t do or what you can write for them?
